name: Special Week
tagline: Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.
self_intro: My name's Special Week! My dream is to be the top Umamusume in all of Japan! I gotta work hard to make my moms proud!
ears: Perks up and teleports to the kitchen when she hears the sounds of cooking
tail: Moves along with her emotions, making her a terrible poker player
family: She gets her eye color from her birth mother

name: Silence Suzuka
tagline: The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.
self_intro: I'm Silence Suzuka. I love to run, and I won't give up my lead to anyone. Uh... that's about it.
ears: Sometimes doesn't hear anything when she thinks about running
tail: She always makes efforts to reduce her wind resistance
family: Gave her more pocket money for shoes

name: Tokai Teio
tagline: Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer.
self_intro: Hey hey! It's Tokai Teio! You might wanna keep an eye on me! Because there's gonna be a new undefeated Triple Crown champion in town!
ears: Never fails to hear praise or the Prez's voice
tail: Wags with excitement when she's receiving attention
family: They cried when she stopped calling them "Mama" and "Papa"

name: Maruzensky
tagline: Keeping it old-school! A real hot rod!
self_intro: Hiii! Maruzensky here! You came here to see me, right? My running's out of this world! Hehe! Try not to fall in love too hard, okay? ♪
ears: Wants to boogie when she hears Eurobeat music
tail: Getting it all silky with a morning shower is her favorite part of the day
family: The bright red sports car is a hand-me-down from her dad

name: Fuji Kiseki
tagline: Always at your service. The classiest racer around.
self_intro: It's everyone's favorite jet-black entertainer, Fuji Kiseki! I'm a modern miracle! I put smiles on faces wherever I go, you know? ♪
ears: Has perfect pitch
tail: Sway gracefully like magnificent feather accessories of the stage
family: Coming from a theater family, her parents travel all over the country

name: Oguri Cap
tagline: A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.
self_intro: I'm Oguri Cap. I'll do my best to win for the folks back home. Thanks for your support.
ears: Can tell apart people from her hometown just from their cheers
tail: She's flexible enough, so there's no spot she can't reach
family: Her family always vacations at hot springs, and knows of at least one hidden spring

name: Gold Ship
tagline: Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else!
self_intro: Bow down! Gold Ship has arrived! Whether I gotta go through a raging inferno, the most downtrodden turf, or even way out there in outer space, I'm always up for adventure! ☆
ears: She covers people's ears and asks "Guess who?"
tail: Sometimes forgets it in her room (according to her)
family: Apparently, it's a national secret

name: Vodka
tagline: Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold.
self_intro: Yo! Vodka here! Listen up. My policy is to be the coolest at all times! I don't act all lame. Got that?
ears: She gets strangely bashful when they're touched
tail: Currently practicing a cool way to swish her tail
family: Often gets scolded by her mom for causing mischief with her dad

name: Daiwa Scarlet
tagline: Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose.
self_intro: Hello! Daiwa Scarlet here! I'll try my best to... What am I saying? "Trying" won't cut it. I will be number one!
ears: Completely betray her true feelings
tail: Fights with her comb everyday to tame her curls
family: Admires and misses her hard-working mother

name: Taiki Shuttle
tagline: A friendly girl born in the U.S.
self_intro: Howdy! Taiki Shuttle here! I'm aimin' to put smiles on some faces with some hard runnin'!
ears: She comes running the second she hears "party"
tail: She uses a tail spray sent by the folks back home
family: Welcome-home fireworks are always at the ready for her

name: Grass Wonder
tagline: Neat and sweet. Japanese at heart, she's back home from the U.S.
self_intro: My name is Grass Wonder. I was born an Umamusume, so I will take this path as far as I possibly can. Hee hee. ♪
strong: Japanese sweets, Japanese culture, competitive karuta
weak: Insects, disrespect for history and tradition
ears: Do not tremble in the slightest when she's doing a tea ceremony
tail: Can get bugs off her back without looking over her shoulder
family: Gets her love of Japan from her parents. Her home has a Japanese-style room

name: Hishi Amazon
tagline: You wanna go? One-on-one! The dorm leader everyone knows and loves.
self_intro: I see a buncha Umamusume here looking like they wanna take me on! Well, Hishiama will give you all you can handle! Come at me! One-on-one!
ears: Can hear someone say "one-on-one" from a mile away
tail: Her glossy black tail is admired by many students
family: Gets her caring nature from her mother and is actually the youngest child

name: Mejiro McQueen
tagline: The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro family. A classy and poised young lady.
self_intro: I am Mejiro McQueen. I shall surely fulfill my family's ambition to claim the Tenno Sho crown.
ears: Tend to stand very straight when she's around others
tail: Swishes her tail excitedly when she talks about sports
family: Her parents call her "Mackie"

name: El Condor Pasa
tagline: The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre.
self_intro: A mighty crimson bird swoops onto the track! It's the one, the only! El Condor Pasaaa, the strongest Umamusume in the wooorld!
ears: Stand up straight whenever she hears someone count
tail: Apparently grabbing the tail is a foul
family: Grew up with a hawk named "Mambo" that was basically a sibling to her

name: TM Opera O
tagline: The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!
self_intro: Muahahaha! Feast your eyes upon your beautiful and powerful Overlord, T.M. Opera O! My legend... begins now!
ears: Hear everything as a compliment
tail: Seems to glisten when light hits it
family: She's thankful to her parents for making a beautiful daughter like her

name: Narita Brian
tagline: Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf.
self_intro: I'm Narita Brian. I'm here to run circles around my opponents, not chit-chat. That's it.
ears: Her blood starts pumping when she hears fanfare
tail: She never cared much for appearances
family: Her parents and sister say her silence is proof of her kindness

name: Symboli Rudolf
tagline: The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute!
self_intro: I am Symboli Rudolf. I hold the honor of being the "Emperor" who seeks to help all Umamusume reach their true potential. Together, let us forge a path to honor and glory!
ears: Twitch noticeably whenever she comes up with a pun
tail: Even the hairs on her tail feel electric when she's giving a speech
family: Her parents have been teaching her the art of governing from a young age

name: Air Groove
tagline: The coolly calculating Empress. Highly gifted and ambitious.
self_intro: I am Air Groove. If you are unwavering in your beliefs, your ideals will blossom. It is my role as Empress to lead by example.
weak: Things that suddenly flash or move
ears: Droop ever so slightly when she takes care of flowers
tail: Uses the same tail oil as her mother
family: Meticulously plans her mom's birthday party a year in advance.

name: Agnes Digital
tagline: I love Umamusume! A super versatile otaku.
self_intro: Hi hi! I'm Digitan! I'm here to support all these sparkling Umamusume! Every day here is a good day! Especially for an Uma Otaku!
ears: Their hair bristles when they pick up an "emotional wave"
tail: She gets her tail done at a salon before concerts
family: Her family loves camping, festivals, and barbecues!

name: Seiun Sky
tagline: Does what she wants, when she wants. As free as a drifting cloud...
self_intro: Hello. I'm Seiun Sky. I'm just taking things as they come. Good things come to those who wait, you know?
weak: Small, confined spaces (The gate, the gate!)
ears: Occasionally stand straight and still when she hears something
tail: Just looks good without doing anything
family: Goes fishing with her grandpa every time she goes home

name: Tamamo Cross
tagline: Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of!
self_intro: I'm Tamamo Cross! I'm gonna race my butt off and make a name for myself! I may not look like much, but ya don't wanna mess with me!
ears: Perk straight up at words like "bargain" and "sale"
tail: Crackles like lightning when she's angry
family: Her younger siblings get to see her soft side

name: Fine Motion
tagline: A sheltered lady excited to make memories that will last a lifetime.
self_intro: Pleased to meet you. I'm Fine Motion. I look forward to making lots of memories here. Would you happen to know of a good local ramen spot?
ears: Keenly interested in hearing about popular culture
tail: The "Royal Tail" is of noble quality
family: She's better at handling her uninhibited sister than her parents

name: Biwa Hayahide
tagline: A fiery intellectual. Logic is her weapon!
self_intro: I'm Biwa Hayahide. My goal is to devise the perfect winning equation... I'd also like to point out that my head is of completely average size!
ears: She's been sensitive to noises since she was little, and was therefore easily startled
tail: Has a hard time getting her tail through the hole in her pants when it's humid
family: Her mother used to have her wear matching hairstyles with her sister

name: Mayano Top Gun
tagline: She's like your sweet little sister. She can't wait to grow up!
self_intro: I'm Maya, heh heh! ☆ I love all things exciting! The thrill of adrenaline's the best! ♪ Nice to meet ya!
ears: Can pop her ears at will
tail: Her tail wags ferociously when she lies
family: Her father is a pilot, and they used to play together at the airport

name: Manhattan Cafe
tagline: Always chasing shadows... Quite the mysterious Umamusume.
self_intro: I'm Manhattan Cafe. I have... a friend I want to catch up with... She's always running ahead of me... You see, right there...
ears: Can hear a voice no one else can
tail: Silky and well-moisturized, even without using any products
family: Her whole family are coffee lovers, so they import coffee beans directly

name: Mihono Bourbon
tagline: Always follows commands! The cyborg Umamusume.
self_intro: My name is Mihono Bourbon. My objective is to win the Triple Crown. Please refer to my specs for information regarding my capabilities.
ears: Perk right up when they hear a command, even if she's dead asleep
tail: Her tail's strong enough that she can stand on it... according to rumors
family: Her family lives an analog lifestyle now because their appliances kept breaking

name: Mejiro Ryan
tagline: Nothing beats a good workout! Even the sweat of her brow is earnest and pure.
self_intro: Sup! Mejiro Ryan here! I'm real big into fitness and lifting. It's all 'bout keeping yourself swole! See you at the gym!
ears: Change positions a lot when she's reading romance manga
tail: She really works up a sweat, so she has a separate towel for her tail
family: Her dad looks so young that he's often mistaken for her brother

name: Hishi Akebono
tagline: Big and generous... portions? Get some more buono in your life! ♪
self_intro: Buono, buono! ♪ Hishi Akebono here! ☆ Whether it's cooking or racing, I put a little bit of love into everything I do!
ears: Can hear the faintest rumble of an empty stomach
tail: Twirls around whenever she whisks ingredients
family: Her father is a master chef, and her mother is a confectionary teacher

name: Yukino Bijin
tagline: She's gonna be a real city girl! Just a hardwork'n girl from the country.
self_intro: My name's, uh, Yukino Bijin! My dream's to run in the Twinkly Series and shine like a real city girl! Whew... I think I managed t' say it all without mess'n up...
strong: Making hot pot dishes, snowball fights
ears: Has a collection of cutesy ear warmers
tail: Currently trying out cheap and cheerful grooming goods
family: Her family's relieved she's retained her dialect even after moving to the big city

name: Rice Shower
tagline: Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.
self_intro: I'm Rice Shower... To be honest, all I ever do is cause bad things to happen, and... I'm really just no good... B-but I'm trying to be better!
ears: Droop when she hears of other people's misfortune
tail: She's mindful not to hit people with her tail
family: Her parents used to read her picture books as bedtime stories

name: Ines Fujin
tagline: Bursting with energy! This girl works hard for her family.
self_intro: Hello-lo! I'm Ines Fujin! I'm here to work hard and race harder to make my family proud!
weight: A bit heavier than last time (too many protein bars?)
weak: Splurging, being asked for help (she can't say no)
ears: Always react to the sound of children's voices
tail: Due to years of sibling antics, they no longer react to being grabbed
family: Her family has a rule to always hold hands when going out

name: Agnes Tachyon
tagline: A mad scientist who fears no law. Weaknesses of the flesh can be overcome!
self_intro: I'm Agnes Tachyon. You wouldn't be interested in finding out just how fast an Umamusume can run, would you? I just so happen to be looking for a guinea pig...
ears: Never, ever touch her ears or forehead
tail: The hairs stand on end when she gets an idea
family: The oddball of a famous racing family

name: Admire Vega
tagline: The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve.
self_intro: My name is Admire Vega... Now, may I please go? I have to train more—win more. So I can be the brightest star.
ears: Twitch involuntarily when someone says "sister"
tail: She has a habit of holding her tail tightly while asleep
family: She prepares two birthday cakes every year

name: Inari One
tagline: You heard right! This Edo Uma is quick as lightning!
self_intro: Watch it, you're talkin' to Inari One! As I'm sure ya can see, I'm an Edo gal through and through—and I'm gonna be the biggest racer in the scene!
ears: Start to dance when they hear festival music
tail: She insists on washing it with hot water even in the heat of summer
family: Her family decides who gets to bathe first with a game of menko

name: Winning Ticket
tagline: Never hold back your feelings! This girl wears her heart on her sleeve.
self_intro: Hey, hey! My dream's always been to become a Derby Champion! OH, RIGHT! MY NAME! I'm Winning Ticket! Keep your eyes on me!
strong: Cheering on friends, feeling her feelings
ears: Her best friend says "Even the way her ears move is annoying"
tail: Expresses her joy, anger, and even sorrow
family: Nothing gets in the way of her family's annual tradition of watching the Derby

name: Air Shakur
tagline: Always takes the logical approach! A brilliant but eccentric racer.
self_intro: The name's Air Shakur. The data always tells the true story, and I've got my simulations on point. Hope everyone's ready to get crushed by my logic.
ears: Stand straight up when she's deep in logical thought
tail: Maintained at the perfect length and volume for running
family: Doesn't open any of the care packages her mother sends

name: Eishin Flash
tagline: Everything she does is according to her plan. A solemn and diligent mädchen.
self_intro: My name is Eishin Flash. I run to preserve Umamusume tradition. I always run right on schedule.
ears: Finds the sound of a metronome calming
tail: She trims it to the most exact millimeter
family: They run a cake shop famous for its baumkuchen

name: Curren Chan
tagline: A shining star of pure cuteness! I need lots of love and attention, okay?
self_intro: Here comes Curren Chan, ready to make the whooole world a cuter place! ☆ Curren's the only girl you need to keep your eyes on! Okay? ♪
ears: If she beckons you, it's because she wants to be spoiled
tail: Ultra-soft and fluffy—almost captivatingly so
family: They miss their daughter so much, they've applied for positions at Tracen Academy

name: Kawakami Princess
tagline: She dreams of being a princess! A bold spitfire of an Umamusume.
self_intro: Ohoho! I am Kawakami Princess. That's right! A princess among princesses. I'm here to smash my opponents into the dirt. Gracefully, of course!
ears: She's proud to have ears most fitting of a tiara
tail: Lovingly named "Princess Tail"
family: Her parents knew to give her clothing that was durable as well as cute

name: Gold City
tagline: A blunt racer and the gold standard in racing and beauty.
self_intro: The name's Gold City. You better not think I'm just another pretty face. I'll let my running do my talking for me.
ears: Will win the struggle against her alarm clock someday
tail: Involuntarily goes completely still when having her picture taken
family: Gets her flawless skin from her mom and her golden blonde hair from her dad

name: Sakura Bakushin O
tagline: This class representative's gone wild! Full Speed Bakushiiiin!
self_intro: Hello! I'm Sakura Bakushin O! As you can tell, I'm the model class representative AND Umamusume! BAKUSHIIIN!
weak: Anything requiring three or more steps
ears: Only hear about half of what anyone says
tail: Good luck grabbing it when she's in full-on Bakushin Mode
family: Her family's motto is "Compliments, compliments, and more compliments!"

name: Seeking the Pearl
tagline: She's taking on the whole world, ready to make the impossible look easy.
self_intro: Hohoho! Seeking the Pearl here! You know the world's your oyster, don't you? I'm here to prove it!
ears: Can understand various words just by their aural "feel"
tail: Mastered calligraphy using her tail to showcase abroad
family: Her whole family has the same pair of sunglasses

name: Shinko Windy
tagline: A total prankster! Watch out: she bites!
self_intro: Grawr! I'm Shinko Windy! Did I scare ya? Aw, come on! Admit it! Hey! I'm talking to you! Chomp!
strong: Playing tricks, digging holes, climbing rooftops
ears: Gets twitchy-eared when coming up with a new prank
tail: Sometimes has drool on it first thing in the morning
family: Whenever a commercial for her dad's company comes on, the whole family sings the jingle

name: Sweep Tosho
tagline: A totally spoiled brat! She swears she'll be a witch someday!
self_intro: Sweep Tosho is just an alias! My true identity is Magical Girl Sweepy! Don't make me cast a spell on you! Hey! Thunk!
strong: Guessing plant names (and sometimes making them up)
ears: To them, unknown words sound like some sort of spell
tail: Treated like a toy by the black cat she tried to befriend
family: Every time she calls her father, he starts crying before hanging up

name: Super Creek
tagline: Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing.
self_intro: Hehe. ♪ I'm Super Creek. I'll work hard to make everyone around me smile. Just leave it to me. ♪
weight: Slight increase (the reason is a secret)
ears: Likes cleaning out people's ears. Does not like having her ears cleaned
tail: Great at calming children
family: Her family runs a daycare with a reputation for warmth

name: Smart Falcon
tagline: Leave the fanservice to her! Self-proclaimed future top Umadol.
self_intro: My name's Smart Falcon, but you can call me Falco! My dream is to become an Umadol! Just let me know if you want my autograph! ☆
ears: Can hear every single one of her fans
tail: She's mindful of how she sits so as not to mess up the hairs
family: Her hair ornament is the first idol costume part that her mother made

name: Zenno Rob Roy
tagline: One day, she'll write her own epic tale. A voracious reader with a rich imagination.
self_intro: My name is Zenno Rob Roy. It's a little embarrassing, but I love fantasy novels, and... well, someday I hope to write my own legend through racing!
strong: Giving very precise directions to places
ears: Bend backwards as a story's climax approaches
tail: Gets nervous in crowds and doesn't move her tail an inch
family: Her parents can talk about the latest household appliances from sunup to sundown

name: Tosen Jordan
tagline: You'll never catch her looking basic! Modern and stylish! ☆
self_intro: Name's Tosen Jordan. My dream is... you know, intros aren't really my thing, so let's skip it. Nice to meecha. ☆ Anyway, check out my nails! Nice, huh?
ears: She wants to popularize selfies with both ears folded up
tail: She always worries whether she missed any split ends
family: She has many memories of being scolded to eat her vegetables first

name: Nakayama Festa
tagline: The ultimate high roller. Lives on the edge and isn't afraid to skirt the law.
self_intro: The name's Nakayama Festa. I need a lot more than a lukewarm race to thrill me, get it? It's gotta be something hotter—hot enough to burn!
strong: Looking after plants and small animals
ears: Cuts and sews her own ear holes for hats
tail: Uses her tail to bluff when making bets
family: The entire family tosses and turns in their sleep

name: Narita Taishin
tagline: Cool and matter-of-fact! Her slight frame gives her an unexpected advantage.
self_intro: The name's Narita Taishin. I'm in this to make all the people who doubted me look stupid. Now leave me alone.
ears: Only pay attention to topics she's interested in
tail: Unless you're a friend, touching it will earn you a swift kick
family: There's a rumor that a BNW mom group is about to form

name: Nishino Flower
tagline: Her smile brightens the room. She's a very thoughtful and kind Umamusume.
self_intro: Hello. My name is Nishino Flower. My dream is to become the kind of Umamusume that everyone can depend on!
ears: Known to be comforting to those who touch them
tail: Smells like the sun and the flowers from each season
family: Still treasures the watering can her parents gave her

name: Haru Urara
tagline: No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up!
self_intro: I'm Haru Urara! I like carrots! Oh, and running too! ♪ I'm always working my hardest to take first place!
weight: Slight increase (but not a big deal)
ears: Big words go in one ear and out the other
tail: She used to think spinning it would make her run faster
family: She likes her mom's carrot rice the best

name: Bamboo Memory
tagline: Lookin' for some real competition! The hot-blooded disciplinary committee chair.
self_intro: Hey, sup! I'm Bamboo Memory. I'm just as tough running the race track as I am running the disciplinary committee, so watch out!
strong: Rising and sleeping early, making swift decisions!
ears: Nearly flop down when removing her hachimaki
tail: Does tail workouts every day
family: Her father, extremely passionate about athletics, is her teacher and origin as an athlete

name: Biko Pegasus
tagline: The flames of justice burn bright in her heart! Feel the heat of this hero!
self_intro: Never fear! Biko Pegasus, defender of justice, is here! I leave my enemies in the dust with my blazing speed! I'm the true people's champion, putting a smile on every person's face!
weight: Slight increase (eating lots to grow big!)
ears: Always react to cries for help
tail: Often gets stepped on when she strikes a hero pose
family: Sunday mornings are tokusatsu time for the whole family!

name: Marvelous Sunday
tagline: Marvelous! She'll change the world with her unbeatable spirit!
self_intro: Hey, hey! It's Marvelous Sunday! I hope you'll join me on my mission to make the world just a little more marvelous wherever I go!
strong: Listening to many people at once
ears: Can distinguish between various marvelous sounds ☆
tail: Her tail's an antenna for seeking out marvelous finds ☆
family: Has a close relationship with her grandmother; they go autumn leaf viewing together

name: Matikanefukukitaru
tagline: Fortune be with me! This charm-tastic Umamusume loves fortune-telling.
self_intro: Greetings! They call me Matikanefukukitaru! My unwavering faith in the great Shiraoki will bring abundant blessings into our lives. Available for divination day and night!
weight: Slight decrease because today is an unlucky day
ears: Sometimes used as directional fortune-telling
tail: Completely stops moving when she's fortune-telling
family: The talented older sister admires her little sister's bright personality

name: Mr. C.B.
tagline: Cheerful and free-spirited, nothing can hold her down!
self_intro: There's a wind you'll only find while racing. It's a gentle tailwind, calm and true to itself. By the way, the name's Mr. C.B.—it's a pleasure.
weak: Standing in a line, lies and flimsy excuses
ears: Can touch her ears with her feet
tail: Switches between different tail care treatments
family: Her parents pretty much eloped instead of having a wedding ceremony

name: Meisho Doto
tagline: In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all.
self_intro: Hi! I-I'm Meisho Doto. I, uh... I... I hope someday I can have the confidence to... Uh... I e-endeavor to... Oh, d-dang, I keep tripping up...
ears: Often tremble slightly
tail: Gets tangled often because she fidgets with it when she worries
family: As a family that's had to travel and move for work a lot, they're are all skilled in languages

name: Mejiro Dober
tagline: She wants to change! This Umamusume bears the scars of her past.
self_intro: Yes, hello. I'm Mejiro Dober. I... plan to race in a way worthy of the Mejiro name.
ears: She tenses up at the sound of a man's voice
tail: Rather than luxury brands, she prefers accessories that best match her hair
family: Her father laments being banned from calling her "Berry"

name: Nice Nature
tagline: Don't expect much from her. This Umamusume is super cynical.
self_intro: Hey. I'm Nice Nature. Haha, truth is, I don't really live up to people's expectations of me, but... that's cool too, you know? I prefer to take it easy.
ears: Always jerk a little anytime she hears "Natie"
tail: She secretly brushes it late at night
family: Articles about her are displayed on the walls of her family's bar

name: King Halo
tagline: Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens!
self_intro: Ohoho! My name is King Halo. As a first-rate competitor, you can naturally expect great things from me. Rest assured, King Halo will be a household name soon enough.
weak: Things unsuitable for a king, such as crowds and heat
ears: Uninterested in hearing anything that isn't first-rate
tail: Even her tail movements are first-rate
family: Her mother is terrible at housework, so they have a full-time maid

name: Matikanetannhauser
tagline: This unpolished gem is loved by all. Today's her day!
self_intro: Hi, hi, Matikanetannhauser here. I need to train as hard as I can to make sure I don't lose... Huh? Wait, there's no training today?!
ears: Able to hear distinct sounds even in noisy environments
tail: Always ends up slanted when she cuts it herself
family: A big banner is strung up across her family's restaurant when she visits home

name: Ikuno Dictus
tagline: Control freak. A skilled Umamusume who can adapt to anything.
self_intro: Well met. I am Ikuno Dictus. Allow me to meet all of your management needs with my iron will.
strong: Earning perfect attendance awards, splitting disposable chopsticks cleanly
ears: The fur is always groomed evenly on both sides
tail: Sometimes used in place of a pointer
family: She is always put in charge of leading family meetings

name: Mejiro Palmer
tagline: Let's have a good time! This Umamusume is upbeat and always there for friends.
self_intro: I'm Mejiro Palmer! How ya doing? I'm always around if you need me, so don't be shy! ♪
ears: Can sense wind speed and direction
tail: Has a tendency to tickle people's legs
family: Her father taught her how to golf, but her handicap is now lower than his

name: Daitaku Helios
tagline: Good vibes only! For real, for real! No cap! ☆ Who's ready to party? This racer!
self_intro: Wahey! Daitaku Helios in the hooouse! My running will have you vibing in no time! Now let me hear you shout! ☆
strong: Outta this world at Old Maid, hype-inducing Umastagram filter expert
weak: Silence is sooo hard, but speaking formally is waaay harder
ears: They move around a ton on sunny days lol
tail: She and her friends make a heart shape with their tails when taking pics
family: My parents always fall for it when I play dead haha

name: Twin Turbo
tagline: Turbo boost! This wild charger knows no limits!
self_intro: Twin Turbo here about to take first place! Let's go! Turbo booost!
strong: Busting through any and all limits
ears: Twitch with joy the more she's backed into a corner
tail: Lacking composure, her tail constantly moves to and fro
family: After seeing their daughter struggle with a weak constitution, they think of her going overboard as a sign of growth

name: Satono Diamond
tagline: Possesses a will harder than diamonds! She can handle any jinx!
self_intro: My name is Satono Diamond. There's no such thing as fate. I intend to race my way into a bright shining future of my own making!
ears: Always have a glossy sheen to them
tail: Perfect to the touch (according to Kitasan Black)
family: Her father is a prominent businessman known for his philanthropic contributions to the racing world

name: Kitasan Black
tagline: Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine.
self_intro: I'm Kitasan Black. I always do my best to create a festive atmosphere that everyone can enjoy when I race!
ears: Excellent sense of pitch
tail: Even her tail can carry a heavy weight
family: Including her father's pupils, her family home houses thirty people

name: Sakura Chiyono O
tagline: Follow your dreams! This Umamusume is honest and hardworking.
self_intro: I-I'm Sakura Chiyono O! My dream is to stand on the same stage as my hero! And I will make my dreams blossom!
ears: Quiver whenever she thinks of a good saying or proverb
tail: She treats it with the same oil that Maruzensky uses
family: Her family often eats dinner around a big hot pot

name: Sirius Symboli
tagline: She's gonna be the biggest star in the world! A charismatic Umamusume of great ambitions.
self_intro: Sirius Symboli, ready to go! There's no room for complaining in a race. Just keep silent and watch—I'm gonna win and prove that I'm the greatest in the world.
ears: Needs earplugs to sleep
tail: Makes a disheveled mess of her tail when irritated
family: Her father insisted on her home tutors changing daily

name: Mejiro Ardan
tagline: She wants to shine bright, no matter how briefly! This well-to-do girl has legs of glass.
self_intro: A pleasure. I'm Mejiro Ardan. My legs may be fragile, but I want to shine brightly on the track, even if only for a moment.
ears: Flip down at the sound of glass breaking
tail: Loves to use custom-made organic treatments
family: Her mother wants to invite all her academy friends to visit

name: Yaeno Muteki
tagline: She runs with the dignity of a warrior. This Umamusume is rough and rugged.
self_intro: I am Yaeno Muteki. As a student of the Kongo Yaegaki style, I am always in search of honorable opponents with whom to race. Let us fight fair and square!
ears: Turn ever so slightly red upon hearing a cute voice
tail: Strong enough to knock down incoming projectiles
family: Always gives her grandfather a shoulder massage when she visits home

name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
tagline: Dreams of the Triple Crown! Always gives 110%! Knows no limits!
self_intro: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi here! I've always dreamed of winning the Triple Crown, and now I'm going all out to—cough, cough! I-I'm all right, just choked on air. Really, never felt better!
weak: The smell of pain-relief patches, low-pressure systems, "strict bed rest"
ears: Flutter happily when someone relies on her
tail: Has to be dried right after washing, or she'll catch a cold
family: Her family often sends her fruit

name: Mejiro Bright
tagline: Hard determination wins at a slow pace! A lady of leisure.
self_intro: ...Oh? Is it time for self-introductions already? Teehee! My name is Mejiro Bright, and I will strive to live up to the Mejiro family name.
weight: Gained a bit of weight (I did eat a lot!)
weak: Eating ice cream before it melts
ears: A good ear cleaning puts her right to sleep
tail: Doesn't bother her when she's sitting on it
family: When the holidays roll around, her entire family is there to welcome her home

name: Daring Tact
tagline: A pure-hearted child of the great outdoors.
self_intro: I'm Daring Tact. My hometown raised me with warmth and discipline, so for its sake... I dream of becoming an Umamusume who goes down in history!

name: Sakura Laurel
tagline: Calm yet persistent. Winter passes, the sakura bloom.
self_intro: My name is Sakura Laurel, and I'm aiming for the top. In other words, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! Hehe, while it may be just a dream for now, someday... I'll make sure it comes true.
strong: Eating salad like it's wanko soba
weak: The moment the plane takes off (everything else is fine)
ears: Her spine and ears straighten when she hears a trumpet
tail: Has a very fluffy tail, same as her mother
family: Learned how to make omelets and galettes directly from her father

name: Narita Top Road
tagline: An energetic honor student! ...But also kind of a supporting character?
self_intro: Hi, I'm Narita Top Road! I'm so thankful to all the people rooting for me. I'll do everything I can to make them proud!
strong: Ultra-long soccer passes, making vocabulary flashcards
ears: She has worked as an ear model
tail: She worries about it fluffing out slightly in humid weather
family: She inherited her fierce, angry glare from her father

name: Yamanin Zephyr
tagline: Though she be gentle as a zephyr, in her soul howls a gale.
self_intro: I'm Yamanin Zephyr... My goal is to be like the wind... running faster and more freely than anything. That's what I aspire to be.
strong: Wind instruments, flying kites, song and dance improv
ears: Butterflies and small creatures like perching on them
tail: Prefers to let it dry naturally
family: Her house back home is famous for being a whimsical dwelling for fairies

name: Furioso
tagline: Her love for Funabashi never wavers. A quiet exchange student from the regional circuit.
self_intro: I'm Furioso. I don't represent the central circuit. I'm a special exchange student from Funabashi. I will show you... the strength of Funabashi.
strong: Guided tours of Funabashi (with a homemade map)
ears: Sway happily at the sound of waves or the touch of a sea breeze
tail: Slaps her leg to snap herself out of it whenever she feels herself being won over
family: Every birthday cake in her family is a pear tart

name: Transcend
tagline: Craving chills and thrills! An info broker chasing the unknown.
self_intro: So yeah, nice to meet ya, Trainer♪ Let's go find something that'll give us chills and thrills!
strong: Video editing, chopstick skills, cat's cradle
ears: Razor-sharp hearing!
tail: Often ends up as a test subject for new tail-care products
family: She deliberately does not follow her parents on social media

name: Espoir City
tagline: Don't underestimate me! A yappy girl in her rebellious phase.
self_intro: I'm Espoir City! Bring on any race! I'll run every last one of 'em ragged... Hey! Who said you could pet me?!
ears: It took her a month to work up the courage to get her first piercing
tail: Gets a quick brush with Rickey's comb ※Brings good luck☆
family: Her family is the loudest cheering section at her younger brother's sports days

name: North Flight
tagline: Radiance is something you hone! A dazzling fashionista.
self_intro: Hi, I'm North Flight! My outfits, makeup, accessories, and tireless effort all make me shine. Take a good look!
strong: Coordinating outfits, yoga, the card game Concentration
ears: She carefully massages her ears to improve circulation
tail: Can be styled in several different ways
family: Her whole family is close with "Big Sis"

name: Symboli Kris S
tagline: Overseas-born. Taciturn. Mission-driven.
self_intro: ...Symboli Kris S here. I owe the Symboli family a debt. As one of its members, I will fulfill both my own goals and carry out the missions I'm given.
ears: Keeps Umamusume with similar ears in her sights
tail: Scrubs it thoroughly with a special shampoo
family: The entire family drinks black coffee for breakfast

name: Tanino Gimlet
tagline: Let my aesthetic overwhelm you! The embodiment of aesthetically divine destruction.
self_intro: The name's Tanino Gimlet! I'm here to find the most ideal version of myself. Life's too short to live as a pale imitation! So kick down the walls, smash them to pieces, and run for Valhalla!
weak: Following established plans, soft-boiled eggs, apples
ears: Who can sing my praises better than I? (Ignoring the interviewer)
tail: Fight preconception! Raise the nation! (Trying to smash a fence with her tail)
family: The nameplate in front of their house is made from recycled bits of destroyed fence (Mom's handiwork)

name: Daiichi Ruby
tagline: Victory is an inevitability with this scion of a glorious house.
self_intro: Greetings. I am Daiichi Ruby. To be ever supreme is the duty of our house. With this calling as my guide, I shall go forth, undaunted.
strong: Writing with a fountain pen, chess
ears: Sometimes perk up when she hears music
tail: The ends curl naturally into a noble style
family: Has photos of her mother and grandmother up in her room

name: Mejiro Ramonu
tagline: A bewitching flower with an unconditional love for racing, blooming in outstanding heights.
self_intro: You wish to know about me? Then step onto the turf. There, you will learn all there is to know about Mejiro Ramonu.
ears: She gets massages all the way to the tips of her ears
tail: Always smooth and streamlined
family: The wintersweet planted in their garden is a family favorite

name: Aston Machan
tagline: Up-and-coming mascot. An ephemeral mystery.
self_intro: I'm Machan. Aston Machan. One day, I'll be a mascot worthy of the world, so keep your eyes steady on me.
ears: Loses earrings often; this is her ninth one
tail: Looking for a style that'll look cute when her mascot goods are mass-produced
family: It was her job to carry her napping mother from the sofa to the bed

name: Satono Crown
tagline: The turf's magician! A reliable, elite big-sister type.
self_intro: I'm Satono Crown. I will bring glory to Satono. I'll prepare for every possibility and turn even adversity into strength to make that happen! You can count on me!
weak: Midsummer sun, days off with no plans
ears: Tend to pin back tightly at crucial moments
tail: She orders the same products used at Satono-affiliated hotels
family: Her family shares even the little details of their day over social media

name: Cheval Grand
tagline: A shy heart harboring ambition. Her goal: becoming a great Umamusume.
self_intro: ...I'm Cheval Grand. Um... I know I'm being presumptuous. But someday, I-I'll be great... No. I'll do my best.
strong: Saltwater fishing, baseball, passing time alone
ears: She takes off her hat and lets her ears catch the breeze when alone
tail: Her younger sister often used to braid it without asking
family: Her family takes turns choosing the destination for trips abroad

name: Verxina
tagline: Onward to her rightful place as "Queen." A strong-willed celebrity Umamusume.
self_intro: I'm Verxina. Until the day I overcome every obstacle and become queen, I refuse to give in.
ears: She can tell which family member threw the ball just from the sound of the catch
tail: Her mother often brushed it for her when she was little
family: Family heart-to-hearts tend to happen while playing catch

name: Vivlos
tagline: A natural at winning affection, with dreams beyond the distant seas.
self_intro: I'm Vivlos! Someday, I'm definitely gonna race like a celeb in dazzling Dubai♪ Let's go together! I've already decided you're coming♪
strong: Handling the cold, baseball, playing celebrity make-believe
ears: Flutter involuntarily when she wants to be pampered
tail: She uses conditioner favored by celebrities
family: Dad's hamburger steaks are a must when the whole family gets together

name: Dantsu Flame
tagline: Kind to a fault! An adorably round girl who's always swept along.
self_intro: I'm Dantsu Flame. Come on, no fighting. How about we grab something sweet and do our best?
ears: She spent three days choosing the color of her ear cover
tail: Bobs up and down while she listens to ghost stories
family: Everyone in her family packs for a move at professional speed

name: K.S.Miracle
tagline: From kindness, miracles are born. A kindhearted, calm Umamusume.
self_intro: ...I'm K.S.Miracle. I vow to bring forth a miracle, for everyone who gave me the opportunity to live.
strong: Giving directions, playing music by ear
weak: Overly strong flavors, the sound of sirens
ears: Sway just a little when she hears laughter
tail: Smells like soap
family: She gets a little more talkative when speaking with her parents

name: Jungle Pocket
tagline: Full speed ahead to the very top! A delinquent graced with flawless charisma.
self_intro: I'm Jungle Pocket. If it's a race you want, it's a race you'll get. Not that you'll be taking the top spot from me anytime soon.
strong: Leading team huddles, climbing trees, kicking off karaoke!
ears: Small birds occasionally perch on them for some reason
tail: Tends to wag wildly around Fuji Kiseki
family: She cannot accept that her older brother is surprisingly popular

name: Believe
tagline: Being the "fastest" is the pinnacle of her craft. An unyielding Umamusume and master of her trade.
self_intro: I'm Believe. I intend to do good work. ...I look forward to working with you.
weak: Stories where something sad happens to a dog
ears: She also relies on sound when mixing mortar
tail: Her grooming brush is a master artisan's little-known masterpiece
family: Her grandparents' house still has height marks on one of its pillars

name: No Reason
tagline: All under heaven, united! No reason needed to chase a dream.
self_intro: Nya-ha-ha! I am none other than No Reason! I will stop at nothing to rule all under heaven. Now, let the uprising begin!
strong: Appraising tea utensils, reading Classical Chinese
weak: Super-thin pillows, the scent of flower nectar
ears: She orders helmets made to fit the shape of her ears
tail: She likes washing it with carbonated shampoo
family: Her father even beats a war drum at home to cheer her on during races

name: Still in Love
tagline: Torn between reason and instinct. A bewitching lady with an unquenched thirst.
self_intro: I'm Still in Love... I... No. There is nothing in particular worth saying about me... Only, yes... things that must remain secret...
strong: Bobbin lace, making jam from red fruit
weak: Large full-length mirrors, strongly scented foods, full moons
ears: Point unwaveringly toward her Trainer
tail: Gives off a faint, pleasant scent when it sways
family: She often discusses history with her father

name: Copano Rickey
tagline: Rickey ☆ Lucky ☆ Super sweet feng shui guru ☆
self_intro: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Great omens abound! ☆ I'm Copano Rickey, and with the power of feng shui, I'll make you happy! ♪
strong: Cleaning, decluttering, taking care of plants
ears: Her dad made her ear covers
tail: Flutters in that day's lucky direction
family: Has many siblings, so the house is always lively ☆

name: Hokko Tarumae
tagline: Running to represent Tomakomai is the grounded hometown idol.
self_intro: From the northern port she flies, a migratory bird on white paper wings. ♪ Hokko Tarumae, local idol and pride of Tomakomai at yer service! Hmm... Maybe I should try making it rhyme?
strong: Acing quizzes on Tomakomai, mountain climbing
ears: Never forgets to accessorize
tail: Moves even more when she's in "local idol mode"
family: The care packages she receives always include cherished hometown sweets from Tomakomai

name: Wonder Acute
tagline: Slow and steady wins the race. An Umamusume with a backbone of steel.
self_intro: I'm Wonder Acute. I may take my sweet time, but I'll get there with slow and steady perseverance. It's lovely to meet you, dearie.
strong: Beadwork, cutting daikon radishes into fanciful shapes
weak: Reading newfangled Western terms, hi-tech gadgets
ears: React to the ringing of a gong
tail: Dexterously avoids contact with nearby objects
family: Within their family, her mother is the most laid-back

name: Samson Big
tagline: Her dreams are bigger than anyone's! A little giant who never stops taking on challenges.
self_intro: I'm Samson Big! I'll take on anything and become a big-time Umamusume known around the world!

name: Sounds of Earth
tagline: Racing is an ensemble! A music-loving Umamusume and true artist.
self_intro: O my beloved musicisti! Join me, Sounds of Earth, and let our melodies intertwine once more today!
strong: Escorting others, caring for silver items
ears: Her ear covers are made by an overseas brand with exacting standards for its fabrics
tail: She uses different tail colognes for everyday wear and formal occasions
family: She and her family often communicate through jam sessions

name: Royce and Royce
tagline: Create a legend! She seeks the title of strongest from her own unique angle.
self_intro: I desire just one thing: the title of "strongest"! I want to become an Umamusume people remember! And what do I need for that? That's right, showmanship!
strong: Data organization (prefers spreadsheets), exercising while doing other things
ears: Instantly picks up any talk about her!
tail: She blends her own tail cologne
family: She once orchestrated her younger sister's elementary school debut

name: Katsuragi Ace
tagline: An energetic girl charging full speed ahead toward her ambition to be racing's top ace!
self_intro: Katsuragi Ace, at your service! Don't be afraid to chase your dreams! I'll help you bust down those claustrophobic walls!
weak: Prepackaged rice, transferring trains, moving walkways
ears: Pumps herself up by putting her ear accessory on last when dressing
tail: Is always up for a good brushing session
family: Was so unruly as a child, she accidentally burned her hand; her family brings the incident up even now

name: Neo Universe
tagline: A cosmic Umamusume—is she somewhat or entirely out of this world?
self_intro: Proposal: A friendly "First Contact." Redefined: "It Is Nice To Meet You."
strong: Forecasting the weather, falling block puzzles
ears: Signal received. Ears in optimal parabola formation.
tail: Becomes akin to a comet's "dust tail" when feeling down
family: She and her father can understand each other's conversation about 54% of the time

name: Hishi Miracle
tagline: A laid-back Umamusume. Another average day of rolling along.
self_intro: Hey, Hishi Miracle here. I guess we could sort of try doing our best together? Anyway, looking forward to working with you.
strong: Finding forest bathing spots, not getting called on in class
ears: Takes time after waking for them to stand upright
tail: Considered dyeing her tail at one point
family: Her parents sent her application to the academy before she could do it herself

name: Tap Dance City
tagline: Friends, dreams, and fortune, she'll claim them all! An Umamusume who lives for grand adventure.
self_intro: Come, set out on a heart-pounding journey! Dance through each day with friends! Everyone! If you've got a dream, climb aboard Tap Dance City's ship!
ears: Twirl around in pursuit of grand adventure
tail: She treats it with oil so it stands out when she dances
family: She takes pride in her mom's marshmallow pie

name: Duramente
tagline: The strongest blood runs through her veins. The culmination of an illustrious lineage.
self_intro: ...I'm Duramente. I seek not victory, but the title of "strongest" that lies beyond it. ...That is all.
strong: Physical fitness tests (especially repeated side steps)
ears: Usually stand tall and proud
tail: She maintains it at what she considers the ideal weight for exercise
family: Her whole family gets fiercely competitive over table tennis on hot spring trips

name: Rhein Kraft
tagline: Into a radiant future! A sunny girl dreaming of the Tiara.
self_intro: I'm Rhein Kraft! I want to inherit others' hopes, blaze a trail, and carry them into the future. That's the kind of Tiara Umamusume I want to be!
strong: Handicrafts of all kinds, rock climbing
ears: Droop loosely during physical affection
tail: Always fluffy and soft
family: A picnic is a tradition whenever the whole family gets together

name: Cesario
tagline: A stern warrior, yet a benevolent Madonna. An Umamusume with two faces.
self_intro: My dearest wish is to claim the Tiara and become the cornerstone of a brilliant future. I look forward to our time together♪
ears: Occasionally pin back when no one wants to be pampered by her
tail: She uses deep-sea water shampoo
family: Her glazed carrot recipe came straight from her mother

name: Air Messiah
tagline: Bearing her love for her mother, she moves steadily... toward a long-cherished dream.
self_intro: My aim is to become a strong and graceful Umamusume... like my mother. I am Air Messiah. I will prove the greatness of what has been passed down, and the preciousness of the future it creates.
strong: Erasing every last trace of chalk when cleaning blackboards
ears: Are actually softer the more she trusts someone
tail: Its beautiful coat was inherited from her mother
family: Everyone in her family keeps a diary in one form or another

name: Daring Heart
tagline: Refined confidence, a dazzling queen's heart!
self_intro: Follow my lead! Keep your eyes on me. The Tiara's radiance is certain to shower down on its future queen, Daring Heart!
strong: Improvising songs on acoustic guitar, brushing tails
ears: She throws a party with friends every time she has them re-dyed
tail: Stays silky and falls beautifully into place even after being washed in river water
family: Her favorite hidden spot for cherry blossom viewing was shown to her by her older brother

name: Fusaichi Pandora
tagline: Jump right in! Limitless hope and a marshmallow heart♡
self_intro: It's Fusaichi Pandora-chan♡ I'm, like, a total genius, so I won't be any trouble at all♡ Sooo, let's make it no Guts training, 'kay?♡
strong: Pretty much everythiiing♡ (quick costume changes, whistling)
weak: Anything too intense is a no-go
ears: Droop as low as possible when she's begging in earnest
tail: Feared for how wildly it thrashes around while she sleeps
family: No one in her family can sleep the night before a trip

name: Buena Vista
tagline: Someday, she'll reach that "breathtaking view." An earnest Umamusume beloved by all.
self_intro: I'm Buena Vista! My dream is to fulfill a promise. To reach that breathtaking view. Nice to meet you, Trainer! ...Hehe.
ears: She can distinguish her fans' voices with impressive accuracy
tail: Leans ever so slightly toward whoever she's walking with
family: She went through a phase where she copied everything her mother did

name: Orfevre
tagline: Above heaven and earth, she alone reigns supreme, a tyrant who calls herself king of the turf.
self_intro: Such insolence. Kneel at once. Bow low and bear witness to Orfevre's path of conquest.
strong: All things in creation, at her command
ears: Her ear ornament was made by her father
tail: Her elder sister always grooms it to perfection
family: She inherited her exceptional artistic sensibilities from her parents

name: Gentildonna
tagline: A noblewoman of iron resolve. She blooms with unbridled strength!
self_intro: Process and reason are meaningless. The victor is always right, wouldn't you agree? I am Gentildonna, and I will make all submit to me.
ears: She is particular enough to coordinate her outfits with her ear cover
tail: She uses a needle-lace tail cover while sleeping
family: Her family's rule is to reach Mount Fuji's third station at age three, fifth station at five, and the summit at seven

name: Win Variation
tagline: Down seven times, up eight. No matter how often she loses, her spirit never breaks!
self_intro: I'm Win Variation. To become the star... the principal dancer, I just gotta keep working! Everyone around me is crazy strong, but I won't give up!
ears: React readily to classical music
tail: She's taken aback when someone touches it, but doesn't dislike it
family: Her mother taught her how to care for her nails

name: Admire Groove
tagline: Noble and dignified, the blue-silver flower that blooms alone.
self_intro: I'm Admire Groove. I have no need for indulgence or kindness. I want to better myself... That is all.
weak: Media scrums, physical contact of any kind
ears: She can't relax without noise-canceling earbuds
tail: She can trim it like a professional
family: Has never stayed up past her bedtime

name: Dream Journey
tagline: She journeys through dreams with a smile. Never peer into the depths of her eyes.
self_intro: If you wish to discuss an expedition, come to me, Dream Journey... I will make it a journey straight out of a dream. You are worthy of nothing less.
ears: Touching is forbidden
tail: Do not touch
family: Not a day goes by without her thinking of her family

name: Calstone Light O
tagline: Beyond the light! Straightaway Supreme charges toward ultimate speed.
self_intro: Calstone Light O. My dream is to set a new top speed. I like straightaways. That is all. Even my introduction is the fastest.
ears: She never misses a cat's meow, no matter how far away
tail: She uses a ruler while grooming it to keep it perfectly straight
family: She can usually tell what her parents are thinking just from their expressions

name: Durandal
tagline: Bear witness! Her flashing legs are a sacred blade of fealty.
self_intro: My sacred blade will shine as it races forth and cut down the darkness that threatens you! I am Durandal, knight of vows and fealty!
strong: Cutting grass, writing lengthy analytical reviews of romance dramas
weak: Staring contests, traveling alone, saying "I surrender"
ears: She never misses a single word of praise
tail: She often wonders if it could be used as a weapon
family: Her family assigns chores with a game of acchi-muite-hoi

name: Bubble Gum Fellow
tagline: Big dreams and explosive fighting spirit! The leader of the charge!
self_intro: I hereby declare: "As the vanguard, I'll unleash a whirlwind with the Four Divine Generals!" Let's make our dreams grow together!
strong: Balloon art, singing Western songs a cappella
ears: She has the sharpest hearing among the "Four Divine Generals"
tail: She likes styling it with pastel-colored accessories
family: Everyone in her family has a faintly sweet, refined scent

name: Sakura Chitose O
tagline: Food itself is medicine. A serene and unflappable sage among Umamusume.
self_intro: I'm Sakura Chitose O. Oh...? You look a little pale. Perhaps you should reconsider your diet. Keeping your qi, blood, and fluids in balance is the source of daily vitality.

name: Fenomeno
tagline: Stern justice. A tough-looking cop racing into action.
self_intro: Reporting! I am Fenomeno of Central Tracen Academy! I shall devote myself body and soul to setting an example for the children!
ears: She secretly loves the majestic fur on her ears
tail: Usually wags in front of the Boss
family: Her whole family prefers chunky red bean paste

name: Blast Onepiece
tagline: Connected to humans by an unbreakable bond. A friendly Umamusume.
self_intro: I'm Blast Onepiece! Humans are so kind, so I love, love, love 'em! I wanna spend more time with 'em and become even better friends!!

name: Almond Eye
tagline: Ultra-competitive ×9! The ultimate challenger.
self_intro: I'm Almond Eye. Even if my opponent is a legend, I will win. I believe it myself, and that's what matters!
ears: She wears leather ear covers for sun protection
tail: She ties it up during yoga
family: Hip-hop gets her whole family hyped on car rides

name: Lucky Lilac
tagline: This flower will survive the long winter and surely bloom in noble splendor.
self_intro: I'm Lucky Lilac. I'll weather any trial to become the star of the turf. Pleased to meet you.
weak: Slugs, abandoned buildings, horror stories about frightening people
ears: She adjusts her gait by listening to her own footsteps
tail: She tries to groom it with camellia oil every day
family: Trips to comedy theaters are a family tradition

name: Gran Alegria
tagline: Infinite miles of potential! The strongest Umamusume miler.
self_intro: Hi, I'm Gran Alegria! Whether the race is 0.75 miles or 1.25 miles, the future mile queen won't lose!
strong: Sports of all kinds, making perfect soft-serve swirls
ears: Ear massages put her to sleep in a flash
tail: She ties it up all the way to the tip with a red ribbon before bed
family: Her family has an "English Day" when everyone speaks English

name: Loves Only You
tagline: Love me♡ Love you♡ A streamer overflowing with love.
self_intro: I'm Loves Only You♪ My love isn't a one-way street, it goes both ways! Let's spread it all around the world on stream♡
strong: Video editing, collaborating with all kinds of people
weak: Drawing, horror games, days off spent doing nothing
ears: She catches background noise from every direction while streaming
tail: Draws cats' attention to keep them from crashing her streams
family: Her family records special occasions on video rather than in photos

name: Chrono Genesis
tagline: An extraordinary racing history buff. She'll create a new era!
self_intro: I'm Chrono Genesis. I love studying racing history... and I hope to etch my own hoofprints into it as well.
ears: She is designing an earring that can hold a pen for taking notes
tail: Starts swaying to the rhythm when a fanfare plays
family: Her whole family holes up in the study until everyone falls asleep

name: Curren Bouquetd'or
tagline: A graceful flower racing onward with wishes and kindness woven together.
self_intro: I'm Curren Bouquetd'or. I enjoy arranging flowers beautifully. And, well... I may not be very good with conflict.
strong: Making balms, braiding tails and hair
ears: A touch of floral-scented oil on the tips
tail: Tends to sync its movements with whoever is nearby
family: The weather is always perfectly clear when she goes out with her mother

name: Stay Gold
tagline: A freewheeling wanderer! Bound for the golden journey she once glimpsed.
self_intro: Good to meet ya, I'm Stay Gold. Come on, let's make this a fun trip! A carefree journey down the golden path.
weight: Doesn't gain weight no matter how much she eats
ears: She gauges others' true intentions from changes in their tone of voice
tail: Somehow stays silky no matter what environment it's exposed to
family: According to her younger sisters, her taste in souvenirs is questionable

name: Red Desire
tagline: An indomitable saint who shall emerge from her trials a savior.
self_intro: My name is Red Desire. The road ahead is filled with trials, but I will overcome them all and become a true saint!
strong: First aid, baking cookies, doing laundry
ears: Manhattan Cafe's voice sounds crystal clear to her
tail: She cleanses it with cold water even in winter
family: She often visited her mother's sets and even appeared as a child actor

name: Kiseki
tagline: A passionate creator who paints miracles.
self_intro: I'm Kiseki! Grueling training, fiery friendships, dramatic victories! In that world of racing, I'll become the hero of the story!
weak: Waiting for results to be announced, rhythm games
ears: React keenly to cool-sounding words
tail: She unconsciously fiddles with it while drawing manga pages
family: The rule is to go to bed without waiting up, even when her parents are coming home late

name: Forever Young
tagline: A charismatic gyaru Umamusume bringing innovation.
self_intro: Hi! I'm Forever Young! The roadmap's all set! Now we just gotta bring some innovation to the Umamusume world!

name: Casino Drive
tagline: A project leader taking on the world's highest summit.
self_intro: I'm Casino Drive. No matter how high the summit, every step takes you closer to the goal. I await your courageous investment.

name: Marche Lorraine
tagline: From behind her puppet, she dreams of seeing the world.
self_intro: U-um... let's see... "Hi☆ I'm Maru-chan♪ My childhood friend Love-chan and I are gonna do our best☆"

name: Epiphaneia
tagline: Hear this voice! A destiny-blessed Umamusume in overdrive.
self_intro: I'm Epiphaneia! Blessed by the "Voice of Destiny," I'll guide everyone to happiness! We're gonna carry destiny to the ends of the universe! Starting now!
strong: Finding the good in others, sailing yachts
ears: She likes how much her ears resemble Symboli Kris S's
tail: She uses the same deep-sea water shampoo as Cesario
family: Her most treasured possession is a Swiss-made wristwatch her father gave her

name: Victoire Pisa
tagline: A messenger of hope joining hearts in a circle of warmth.
self_intro: My name is Victoire Pisa. Through my running, I wish to link the world in a ring of hope, so that no one is ever "all alone."
strong: Playing the trumpet, dividing sweets evenly
ears: They're fluffy, and she often lets her friends touch them
tail: She ties it up with a turquoise-adorned hair tie
family: Every piece of furniture in her family home is meticulously positioned

name: Rose Kingdom
tagline: A prince of roses carrying her family's long-held hopes.
self_intro: I am Rose Kingdom, a member of the House of Roses and the one who will fulfill its long-held dream. ...I am counting on your support.
strong: Eating without clinking her dishes or cutlery
ears: She likes to wear ear caps in the bath whenever possible
tail: Gives off the scent of roses when it flutters in the wind
family: A commemorative rose is planted for each member of her family on the day they are born

name: Rulership
tagline: A calculating master of the game board, but her heart is made of glass.
self_intro: I'm Rulership. With my perfect strategy, I shall elegantly dominate the game board that is the Twinkle Series!
strong: Board games of all kinds, swimming, psychology
ears: She feels more at ease with a headset on
tail: Often has marks from her sleeping bag
family: She concentrates better with her younger brother's piano playing in the background

name: Efforia
tagline: A lady of an illustrious house who races as destiny commands.
self_intro: ...I am Efforia. Whatever the race, I will prevail without fail, if that is the destiny I am bound to follow.

name: Phalaenopsis
tagline: A flower of the battlefield, breaking her shackles and bursting into bloom.
self_intro: I am Phalaenopsis. No adversity or misfortune can daunt me. To repay the kindness I once received, I shall crush all that stands in my way.
ears: Her ear covers were handmade by the children at her old club
tail: She always ties it up with a motoyui hair cord before bed
family: Her family is always ready for battle, with bamboo practice swords in every room

name: Happy Meek
tagline: The epitome of gentle. Talents of the greatest scale take time to bloom!

name: Tazuna Hayakawa
tagline: The secretary to the Tracen Academy director has a wonderful smile.
self_intro: Hello. I'm Tazuna Hayakawa, the Tracen Academy director's secretary. I'm here to ensure that everyone has the best on-campus experience possible. ♪

name: Yayoi Akikawa
tagline: Welcome! Tracen Academy's director, brimming with love for her students.
self_intro: I am Yayoi Akikawa, director of Tracen Academy! I intend to give my all for our students and the Trainers who support them!! By all means, rely on me as much as you please!!

name: Aoi Kiryuin
tagline: Meeting challenges head-on! This trainer is highly motivated.
self_intro: Hello. I'm Aoi Kiryuin, a new trainer here at Tracen Academy. I'm still learning as I go, but I'll do my absolute best!

name: Sasami Anshinzawa
tagline: The subject of pointed interest wherever she goes. World's greatest(?) acupuncturist.
self_intro: Sasami Anshinzawa, (apprentice of a) legendary acupuncturist, at your service! With one little poke, I'll have you ready to take on the world! Wow, right? No worries! ☆

name: Riko Kashimoto
tagline: A professional straight from the URA, she is firm yet kind.
self_intro: I'm Riko Kashimoto. It is the role of a trainer to look after the health of their Umamusume. Therefore, it's appropriate to have some level of anxiety regarding one's work.

name: Light Hello
tagline: The event producer connecting hearts and creating stages where everyone can shine.
self_intro: My name's Light Hello, and I'm mainly an event planner. I'd be happy to give everyone on stage a nudge so they can shine their brightest.

name: Darley Arabian
tagline: A cheerful and wise leader who values individuality.
self_intro: I'm Darley Arabian. Every Umamusume has something that makes them special—each one a star. I'll help you fulfill their potential, little lamb!

name: Godolphin Barb
tagline: An elegant teacher brimming with an all-encompassing kindness.
self_intro: Call me Godolphin Barb. It's our bonds with the people important to us that give us the impetus to run. I will lend you my strength too.

name: Byerley Turk
tagline: Beneath the tough, soldierly persona lies a heart with a deep love for her fellow Umamusume.
self_intro: My name is Byerley Turk. Strength is of the utmost importance for an Umamusume. Those I train will become strong enough to carve their legends into the track.

name: Mei Satake
tagline: A dream-chasing leader who never stops taking on the world.
self_intro: I'm Mei Satake! Leave analysis of European races to me. Together, let's achieve the unprecedented dream of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

name: Ryoka Tsurugi
tagline: A capable producer striving to create the ultimate entertainment.
self_intro: I'm Ryoka Tsurugi. Each day, I produce a wide variety of content. I will deliver the most moving experiences to all of you.

name: St Lite
tagline: Japan's first Triple Crown Umamusume, a model of how greatness is achieved.
self_intro: St Lite. As the first to claim Japan's Triple Crown, I shall bestow wisdom and blessings upon you all.

name: Speed Symboli
tagline: The legendary pioneer who forged a path to the world.
self_intro: I am Speed Symboli, one who believes in the limitless potential within you. Now, shall we turn the world upside down?

name: Haiseiko
tagline: A nationwide superstar☆ The monster idol who sparked a frenzy♪
self_intro: Hello, I'm Haiseiko! The original li'l Monster is gonna gobble up your heart, too. Chomp♪

name: Tucker Bryne
tagline: She charges ahead with a fiery heart at the helm of the Desert Island Project.
self_intro: My name is Tucker Bryne! I launched the Desert Island Project to help all you Umamusume soar to even greater heights! Now, unleash your instincts!!

name: Kiyoko Hoshina
tagline: A hot spring goddess who has mastered the art of "recuperation."
self_intro: My name is Kiyoko Hoshina, proprietress of Yukoma Inn. Hot springs do wonders for fatigue and injuries. You bet, good health comes first... Oh, pardon me. Hohoho!
